reason: My customers buy from me because they know me, from the fair, from a call, from someone who vouched for me. I might take the free list of 15 companies to see if they know my niche, but I would not sign a pilot from an agency in Sofia I have never met when I could put Apollo and a junior on it for less.
objection: A message written by outsiders, even signed with my name, is not a relationship. If a buyer finds out it was an agency, I lose face, and 350 euro for one meeting is a lot when one good referral costs me nothing.
would_change_my_mind: A wholesaler like me, not a logistics firm, who I can call and who tells me the meetings turned into real orders.
